name: Export confirms, wordmark closes
looks: A three-word punch headline lands, the last word in the accent colour. A phone screen shows an export-complete state: a checkmarked thumbnail, a small free-tier notice, and two buttons (share, download). It cuts to the app icon and wordmark on black, a short tagline, a small mascot character, and a store badge.
build: kinetic-word-run for the three-word headline, hard cut per word. The export screen's checkmark scales in with a spring, and the two buttons get a quick press-scale as the cursor taps one (glass-ui-flow's press mechanic). The close is wordmark-assemble's letter-drop, with the mascot and store badge fading in last.
sound: A hit per headline word, a confirm chime on the checkmark, and a soft tick per letter on the closing wordmark.
prompt: Close the demo by finishing the job: a short three-word punch line lands hard-cut, a real export-complete screen confirms the file is ready to share or save, then settle on the brand's icon, name, tagline and a small friendly mascot as the sign-off.
